title: case.yaml
description: A case of the public benchmark (TRUST5): a solved research on persons dead for more than a hundred years, from open sources. The case folder holds case.yaml, project/ (the starting project, without the answer) and solution/ (the research carried out).

id.description: the case's id, its folder's name

question.description: the starting question, as a person asks it

family.description: the family of project/ and solution/

research.description: the research of solution/ that answers the question

expected.description: the known answers, as bench/run.py scores them

person.description: a person id of solution/, or Given SURNAME

place.description: the expected place, or the names of a commune known under several

abstain.description: the right answer is: not found

fact.description: the fact of solution/ that gives it

label.description: a name for this answer, that distinct refers to

date.description: check: the date the fact must carry, the same text or within tolerance_days

tolerance_days.description: with date: how many days the fact's full date may be off; 0 when absent

axes.description: check: the axes the fact must carry in its evidence (those given)

confidence_max.description: check: the highest confidence a question answered on the fact may reach

uncertain_reading.description: check: true, the fact must carry an uncertain_reading; false, it must not

distinct.description: check: the label of another answer, whose person must be another person (homonyms)

sources.description: every source the solution cites, with the terms that let it be reused

licence.description: the licence or the terms of reuse, such as Licence Ouverte 2.0, CC BY 4.0, public domain

reviewed.description: who read the solution and agreed to its publication

observed.description: the case informs and blocks nothing: its scores are reported, never held against a release threshold

offline.description: the acts the research needs are in project/ (sources.yaml and their transcriptions): it needs no search, and a bench may play it without web tools
